sights.n: Poké Lid — Growlithe & Shureimon, Ryūtan Plaza, Shuri (ポケふた ガーディ×守礼門 龍潭広場)
sights.address: Ryūtan Hiroba, 18 Shuri Ikehata-chō, Naha, Okinawa, Japan
sights.w: A Pokémon manhole cover (Poké Lid) showing Growlithe, Okinawa's official 'support Pokémon', in front of Shureimon gate. It was unveiled at Shureimon on 24 October 2025 and set into the paving of Ryūtan Plaza, the small city plaza on Ryūtan-dōri by Jōsei Elementary School, about 200 m from the Shuri Castle bus stop. It is the Shuri stop on the OCVB 'Flying Pikachu' Poké Lid trail.
sights.anime: Pokémon (Poké Lids / Pokémon Local Acts) — Growlithe, Okinawa's 'support Pokémon', with Shureimon; part of the prefecture-wide Poké Lid trail

sights.n: Poké Lid — Growlithe over Mihama fireworks, Depot Island Boardwalk, Chatan (ポケふた ガーディ 北谷町美浜)
sights.address: Depot Island Boardwalk (seaside), 9-1 Mihama, Chatan Town, Okinawa 904-0115, Japan
sights.w: A Pokémon manhole cover installed in August 2025 at the seaside boardwalk of Depot Island in Mihama. It shows Growlithe, Okinawa's 'support Pokémon', against American Village's night skyline and fireworks. It sits just before the boardwalk steps, which is also a popular fireworks-viewing spot. It is one of four Growlithe lids the Pokémon Company gave to Okinawan towns in 2025.
sights.anime: Pokémon (Poké Lids / Pokémon Local Acts) — Growlithe, Okinawa's 'support Pokémon', over American Village fireworks

sights.n: Poké Lid — Solrock & Skiploom, Kumiodori Park, Urasoe (ポケふた ソルロック×ポポッコ 組踊公園)
sights.address: Kumiodori Park (south plaza of the National Theatre Okinawa), 4-14-1 Jitchaku, Urasoe, Okinawa 901-2122, Japan
sights.w: Urasoe's Pokémon manhole cover was set into Kumiodori Park, next to the National Theatre Okinawa, in February 2022. That made Urasoe the fifth city in the prefecture with a Poké Lid. Solrock stands for the sun (tida), Urasoe's symbol, and Skiploom carries yellow flowers in the colour of the city flower. It is on the OCVB 'Flying Pikachu' Poké Lid trail.
sights.k: Pokémon manhole at the National Theatre
sights.anime: Pokémon (Poké Lids / Pokémon Local Acts) — Solrock (Urasoe's sun, tida) and Skiploom, beside the home of kumiodori

sights.n: Poké Lid — Tauros & Katsuren Castle, Ishikawa Sports Grounds, Uruma (ポケふた ケンタロス×勝連城跡 石川運動広場)
sights.address: Entrance of Ishikawa Sports Grounds, Uruma Ishikawa Sports Complex, 1-2 Ishikawa-Ishizaki, Uruma, Okinawa 904-1104, Japan
sights.w: Uruma's Pokémon manhole cover shows a charging Tauros, a nod to the city's bullfighting (tōgyū) culture, with the UNESCO-listed Katsuren Castle ruins behind it. It was installed at the entrance of the Ishikawa Sports Grounds as part of Pokémon's 'Flying Pikachu Project' and is on the OCVB Poké Lid trail.
sights.anime: Pokémon (Poké Lids / Flying Pikachu Project) — Tauros for Uruma's bullfighting culture, with Katsuren Castle
